label: Pecorino di Pienza stagionato in barriques

about.text: A small, hard sheep's-milk cheese from the Siena area, mainly Montefollonico. It is pasteurised, acidified and salted, then aged at least 90 days in oak barriques (wine barrels), and is listed as a traditional product (PAT).
